versions.content: Semantics of the explicitInterRunnableVariable The semantics of the explicitInterRunnableVariable is that explicit implies the di- rect access to the value of a VariableDataPrototype used in the role explicit- InterRunnableVariable . By this means it is possible to get different values for a specific VariableDataPro- totype each time the corresponding API call is executed.
